TASK: wire two finished read-only modules into Swarm Watch. tools/split-quality.mjs exports splitQuality({ root, now, slots, windowDays }) -> { metrics: [{key,label,value,display,unit,grade,basis,note}], grade, at } (roadmap R-027: 'A Split quality panel per project shows overhead ratio, first-try pass rate, critical path, wave fill, collisions, review $ per ticket and ticket sizes, each green, amber or red'). tools/benchmark-scorecard.mjs exports readBenchmarks(root) and scorecard(files, { now, weeks }) -> { metrics: [{key,label,unit,better,baseline,latest,change,changePct,verdict,weekly:[{week,value}]}], weeks, skipped, files } (contract: docs/benchmarks-format.md). Do NOT change those two modules' behavior, and do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, package.json, CHANGELOG.md or README.md. Note: split-quality.mjs imports readRunStates from board-data.mjs; importing split-quality.mjs from board-data.mjs is a safe ESM cycle (only used at call time) — keep it that way or pass runs in, your choice, without changing splitQuality's output. 1) tools/board-data.mjs: - projectDetail gains `splitQuality` (await splitQuality({ root: project.root, now, slots }), null on error) and `benchmarks` (scorecard(await readBenchmarks(project.root), { now }), null on error; when files === 0 keep the object so the page can say 'no baseline yet'). Add an injectable `slots = null` option to projectDetail. - projectOverview gains `split: { grade, reds: number of red metrics, worst: label of the first red (else first amber) metric or null }` from splitQuality({ root, now, slots }) (null on error). boardSnapshot passes `slots: workers?.max ?? null` through to projectOverview. Keep every existing field. 2) tools/watch-cli.mjs: pass `slots` (the machine worker limit `max` already computed in the snapshot path; compute it the same way in the project path) into projectDetail. Nothing else. 3) tools/watch-assets/project.html: in the Overview pane add, right after the Build progress card, `

Split quality

` and `

Benchmark scorecard

`. 4) tools/watch-assets/project.js (textContent/setAttribute only, never innerHTML): - renderSplit(p.splitQuality): a header line with the overall grade pill; then one row per metric: a colored dot by grade (class 'grade-green|grade-amber|grade-red|grade-unknown'), the label, the display value, and a sub line with the basis (or the note when grade is unknown); the row's title attribute = note. null -> 'Split quality unavailable.' - renderBench(p.benchmarks): files === 0 -> 'No baseline yet. The MacBook writes docs/state/benchmarks/-
